sum by (ceph_daemon, disk_id) (label_join((label_replace(ceph_osd_metadata{device_class="hdd"}, "device", "sda", "", "") or label_replace(ceph_osd_metadata{device_class="ssd"}, "device", "nvme0", "", "")), "disk_id", "/", "hostname", "device")) * on(ceph_daemon) group_left() (avg_over_time((sum by (ceph_daemon) (ceph_osd_up))[$__range:]) * 100)
